mentions.name: Tactus
mentions.description: An NES game called Tactus. Recent work includes composing a new song for the game, with the percussion track still needing refinement, and preparing the game and its business side for a first outing at a convention.
mentions.source_excerpt: This weekend I'm working on a new song for my NES game, Tactus. I've been busy setting up the business and preparing for its first outing at a convention, so it was nice to relax and just create for a bit.
